Uthman missed Badr to tend his ill wife, the Prophet's daughter, and the Prophet promised him the reward and share of one who fought there.
Uthman gets glad tidings of Paradise along with a calamity and has Al-Walid flogged; he is ranked after Abu Bakr and Umar, and Ibn Umar answers charges against him.
Urged to punish his brother Al-Walid, Uthman recalls his two migrations and loyalty to the Prophet, Abu Bakr and Umar, and has Al-Walid flogged forty lashes.
